cases.question: which course can I learn how to use terraform?
cases.standalone_question: Which BCIT course teaches how to use Terraform?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You can learn how to use Terraform in several BCIT courses, including **COMP 4964** (DevOps Engineering) and **ACIT 4640**.

* **COMP 4964 (DevOps Engineering):** Covers Terraform and Ansible during week 12 as part of its curriculum on cloud-based environments, continuous delivery, and infrastructure tools.
* **ACIT 4640:** Introduces Terraform syntax and commands starting in week 4, and covers Terraform modules, variables, and state in later weeks.
* **Computer Systems Technology (CST) Diploma - Cloud Computing Option:** This full-time program option incorporates industry-standard infrastructure and DevOps tools, including Terraform, into its hands-on cloud curriculum.

Sources:

- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20261089230/
